input_signals.name: Renewal Surplus Conjunction
input_signals.expression: MIN(IND_RANK(RATIO(oancf, at)), IND_RANK(NEG(RATIO(SUB(capx, dp), ppent))))
input_signals.hypothesis: Firms combining strong operating cash profitability with limited capital spending beyond depreciation earn higher subsequent returns.
input_signals.reasoning: Capex above depreciation measures expansion beyond replacement needs, while operating cash flow captures the resources generated by existing assets. The minimum operator requires both cash profitability and investment restraint to be strong, rather than allowing either theme to dominate independently.
input_signals.author: proposer
input_signals.normalized_expression: min( ind_rank( ratio( oancf, at ) ), ind_rank( neg( ratio( sub( capx, dp ), ppent ) ) ) )

input_signals.name: Profitable Inventory Divergence
input_signals.expression: MUL(INDICATOR(IND_ADJ(RATIO(SUB(revt, cogs), at)), 0), MIN(IND_ZSCORE(WINSOR(RATIO(DELTA(invt, 1), LAG(at, 1)), 1)), IND_ZSCORE(WINSOR(NEG(RATIO(DELTA(SUB(revt, cogs), 1), LAG(at, 1))), 1))))
input_signals.hypothesis: Above-industry gross-profit firms that expand inventory while gross profit weakens earn lower subsequent returns.
input_signals.reasoning: The minimum operator produces a high signal only when elevated inventory investment and weak gross-profit change occur together, so it is not an unconditional inventory-growth proxy. Conditioning on above-industry gross profitability targets firms whose established profitability may cause investors to overlook emerging inventory-demand divergence; lagged-asset scaling, winsorization, and industry standardization improve comparability and stability.

input_signals.normalized_expression: mul( indicator( ind_adj( ratio( sub( revt, cogs ), at ) ), 0 ), min( ind_zscore( winsor( ratio( delta( invt, 1 ), lag( at, 1 ) ), 1 ) ), ind_zscore( winsor( neg( ratio( delta( sub( revt, cogs ), 1 ), lag( at, 1 ) ) ), 1 ) ) ) )

input_signals.hypothesis: Above-industry profitable firms that simultaneously increase capital spending and issue substantial equity earn lower subsequent returns.
input_signals.reasoning: A high signal requires the conjunction of accelerated real investment and contemporaneous equity issuance, conditional on strong operating profitability; neither external financing nor capex growth alone is sufficient.
